description: Original JSON reports referenced by the two recorded Core full-suite stdout streams. Only these reports are archived; no entire pytest directory is copied.

cephfs.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --tb=short -rs --basetemp=/hot-data/fsx/workspace/erik/orze-autonomy-verification-2026-09-12.D3hLyG/core-pytest --junitxml=/hot-data/fsx/workspace/erik/orze-autonomy-verification-2026-09-12.D3hLyG/core.junit.xml

source_binding.command:
set -o pipefail
git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -z -- src tests examples pyproject.toml | sort -zu | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum

ext4.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --tb=short -rs --basetemp=/tmp/orze-autonomy-full.RY05QFxJ/pytest --junitxml=/tmp/orze-autonomy-full.RY05QFxJ/junit.xml

source_binding.concurrent_changes: Evidence and plans only; no source/test edits.

archive.format: gzip-compressed tar; regular JSON members use original absolute paths with the leading slash removed
archive.deduplication: Repeated references to the same original path are represented by one tar member and all occurrences. A same-path hash/size conflict aborts. This run contains no repeated paths.

preflight.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import collections,hashlib,json,re,stat,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.').resolve();records={};epochs={};logs={};testcases={};decoder=json.JSONDecoder()
for epoch in ['cephfs','ext4']:
 p=root/('docs/evidence/2026-09-12-core-autonomy-'+epoch+'-full.json');raw=p.read_bytes();report=json.loads(raw)
 output=''.join(x['output'] for x in report['raw_tool_results']);logs[epoch]=output
 junit=report['junit'];jp=root/'docs/evidence'/junit.get('path',junit.get('archive'));jb=jp.read_bytes()
 assert jb==Path(junit['original']).read_bytes()
 if 'sha256' in junit: assert hashlib.sha256(jb).hexdigest()==junit['sha256']
 tree=ET.fromstring(jb);cs=tree.findall('.//testcase');cases={}
 for node in cs:
  key=(node.attrib.get('classname',''),node.attrib['name']);assert key not in cases,key
  marks=[tag for tag in ['failure','error','skipped'] if node.find(tag) is not None];assert len(marks)<=1
  cases[key]=marks[0] if marks else 'passed'
 testcases[epoch]=cases
 counts=collections.Counter(cases.values());assert counts['failure']==report['result']['failed'];assert counts['passed']==report['result']['passed'];assert counts['skipped']==report['result']['skipped'];assert counts['error']==0
 markers={}
 for marker in ['HOLDOUT_REPORTS','CPU_RECOVERY_REPORTS','ACCEPTANCE_REPORTS']:
  matches=list(re.finditer(re.escape(marker)+'=',output));assert len(matches)==1,(epoch,marker,len(matches))
  values,end=decoder.raw_decode(output[matches[0].end():]);assert type(values) is list;markers[marker]=len(values)
  for ordinal,value in enumerate(values):
   q=Path(value['path']);assert q.is_absolute() and q.suffix=='.json';assert stat.S_ISREG(q.lstat().st_mode) and not q.is_symlink()
   data=q.read_bytes();sha=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest();assert type(value['bytes']) is int and len(data)==value['bytes'];assert sha==value['sha256'];json.loads(data)
   entry={'original':str(q),'member':str(q).lstrip('/'),'sha256':sha,'bytes':len(data)}
   occurrence={'epoch':epoch,'marker':marker,'ordinal':ordinal,'declared':value}
   if str(q) not in records: records[str(q)]={**entry,'occurrences':[]}
   else: assert all(records[str(q)][k]==entry[k] for k in entry)
   records[str(q)]['occurrences'].append(occurrence)
 epochs[epoch]={'report':{'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw)},'result':report['result'],'command':report['command'],'commit':report['commit'],'junit':{'path':str(jp.relative_to(root)),'original':junit['original'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(jb).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(jb),'testcases':len(cs),'counts':dict(counts)},'markers':markers,'stdout':{'bytes':len(output.encode()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(output.encode()).hexdigest(),'chunks':[x['chunk_id'] for x in report['raw_tool_results']]},'source_binding':report['source_binding']}
assert testcases['cephfs'].keys()==testcases['ext4'].keys()
failures=[{'classname':k[0],'name':k[1],'before':v,'after':testcases['ext4'][k]} for k,v in testcases['cephfs'].items() if v in ['failure','error']]
assert len(failures)==97 and all(x['after']=='passed' for x in failures)
assert all(v==testcases['ext4'][k] for k,v in testcases['cephfs'].items() if v not in ['failure','error'])
entries=sorted(records.values(),key=lambda x:x['original']);occurrences=sum(len(x['occurrences']) for x in entries)
print(json.dumps({'epochs':epochs,'comparison':{'testcase_keysets_equal':True,'unique_testcases':len(testcases['ext4']),'failed_then_passed':failures,'remaining_outcomes_unchanged':True},'archive':{'occurrences':occurrences,'unique_paths':len(entries),'duplicates_deduplicated':occurrences-len(entries),'json_bytes':sum(x['bytes'] for x in entries),'entries':entries},'logs':logs},sort_keys=True))
PY
preflight.output_layout: Full preflight output fields are preserved as epochs/comparison/archive above and logs in raw_logs; no output or report contents reconstructed from test expectations.

limits: Record and byte-consistency verification only, not a fresh semantic validation of every experiment, an execution authorization or a cryptographic attestation.
The successful short /tmp run does not make CephFS a supported runtime root; the first failed run remains intact.
No worker/test execution, source edits, old-report edits, commit or push in this archive operation.
